question: The time allowed to the central government to remove any difficulty in implementing the New Delhi International Arbitration Centre Act, 2019 has been extended to ______ years from the date of commencement by The New Delhi International Arbitration Centre (Amendment) Bill, 2022.
solution:
The correct answer **is 5**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **The New Delhi International Arbitration Centre (Amendment) Bill, 2022 has extended the time allowed to the central government to remove any difficulty in implementing the New Delhi International Arbitration Centre Act, 2019 to 5 years **from the date of commencement.
 
• The** New Delhi International Arbitration Centre (NDIAC) was established in 2019 **as an independent and autonomous institution for the resolution of domestic and international commercial disputes.
 
• **The NDIAC Act, 2019 aimed to make India a hub for international** commercial arbitration by providing a framework for the establishment of a world-class arbitration institution
